access.title: Your access
access.body: Read-only access for {firm} to the books of {company}, given by {name}. It ends on {date}. Every download is recorded.
access.bodyNoName: Read-only access for {firm} to the books of {company}. It ends on {date}. Every download is recorded.
access.preview: You are looking at {firm}'s room as the office: it shows the files of {company} as the accountant sees them, and nothing is downloaded from a preview.

period.title: Period
period.hint: Choose a month, a quarter or a year. The rest of the page follows the period; you see the months finance has handed over.
period.someMissing_one: {count} month of this period is not handed over yet: ask finance.
period.someMissing_other: {count} months of this period are not handed over yet: ask finance.
period.noneYet: Finance has not handed over any period yet
period.noneYetBody: A month appears here once finance has made its accounting export. Ask finance below.

exports.title: Accounting exports
exports.hint: The numbered exports finance made for you. A re-export carries only what changed since the export it amends.
exports.empty: No export for this period yet

einvoices.title: E-invoices
einvoices.hint: Every sales and purchase invoice of the period: the FatturaPA XML, and the PDF copy when there is one.
einvoices.emptyBody: Nothing was issued or received in the months handed over.
einvoices.noFile: No file is kept for this invoice.

registers.title: VAT and registers
registers.hint: What the exports carry besides the journals: the Intrastat file and the year-end stock pack. A later export replaces the whole file.
registers.empty: No register file in this period
registers.emptyBody: The Intrastat file comes with a month's export, the stock pack with the year end.
registers.later: {items} are not made by the system yet: ask finance for them.

no.xml: No XML is kept for this invoice.
no.pdf: No PDF copy is kept for this invoice.

package.COST_OF_SALES: Cost of goods sold and variances

state.NOT_DELIVERABLE: Not deliverable (in the buyer's tax area)
state.failed: We could not read your accounting files
state.failedBody: Nothing was lost. Try again in a moment.
state.listFailed: We could not read this period
state.listFailedBody: Nothing was lost. Try again in a moment.

held.preview: This is the office's preview: nothing is downloaded from it.
held.offline: No connection: downloads wait until you are back online.
held.busy: A download is on its way.
held.reading: The period is still being read.
held.nothing: There is no file in this period.

refusal.NOT_ACCOUNTANT: This page is the accountant's: your access does not open it.
refusal.PERIOD_NOT_SHARED: Finance has not handed this period over yet: it has no accounting export. Ask finance.
refusal.FILE_NOT_IN_PERIOD: This file is not one of this period's: the period was read again.
refusal.TOO_MANY_FILES: A zip holds at most 400 files: choose a shorter period or fewer files.
refusal.TOO_LARGE: A zip holds at most 100 MB: choose a shorter period or fewer files.
refusal.NOTHING_TO_ZIP: There is no file to put in the zip.
refusal.FILE_UNAVAILABLE: These files cannot be downloaded right now. Try again later, or ask finance.
refusal.generic: The download did not work. Try again.
refusal.network: The factory is not answering. Try again in a moment.

noAccess.title: Not part of your access
noAccess.body: This page is the accountant's room of the company's books.

office.title: Accountant access
office.hint: The accounting firm reads the batches in its own portal: the months you exported, their e-invoices and registers for {company}, files only, until the day you set. Every download is recorded below.
office.emptyBody: Give your accounting firm read-only access to the exports, e-invoices and registers.
office.noFirm: First add the accounting firm as an organisation and give it the Consultant role on its record.
office.failed: We could not read who has access
office.stepUp: Giving, changing or ending the accountant's access opens or closes the company's books to an outside firm: type the code from your authenticator app.

held.reading: The access is still being read.
held.noManage: Only finance gives, changes or ends accountant access.
held.noFirm: Add the accounting firm with the Consultant role first.
held.expired: The invitation expired: give access again.
held.someLeft: Some of the chosen people have no access any more.
held.busy: Wait: a change is on its way.

invite.title: Give the accountant access
invite.body: The person gets an e-mail with the sign-in page of the portal. They sign in with a code we e-mail them; no password.
invite.everyCompany: {firm} works for every company of the group: the person can open the files of any company whose portal they sign in to.
invite.name: Name
invite.what: They see only the months you exported: the exports, the e-invoices (XML and PDF) and the registers; read-only, never a record or someone's pay.

problem.name: Write the person's name.
problem.until: Choose the last day of access.
problem.past: The last day of access cannot be in the past.

change.title: Change the end of access of {name}
change.body: The access lasts until the end of the day you choose, then ends by itself.

end.body: Their sessions end at once and their open invitation stops. You can give access again later.

done.invited: {name} is invited: the sign-in page went to {email}.
done.invitedOn: The firm's portal is on and {name} is invited: the sign-in page went to {email}.
done.changed: The end of access of {name} is saved.
done.ended_other: The access of {count} people has ended.

problem.firm: This organisation cannot get accountant access: it needs the Consultant role and to be of this company.
problem.email: This address belongs to someone else (an office person or another organisation), or already has access.
problem.until: The end of access is not valid: choose a day in the future.
problem.conflict: Someone changed this meanwhile: the list was read again. Try once more.
problem.forbidden: Your role does not let you change this access.
problem.invalid: Something in the form is not valid: check the fields.
problem.unavailable: The factory is not answering. Try again in a moment.
problem.generic: The change did not go through. Try again.

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.hint: The newest downloads of the company's accountants: who, when and what.
